artifact.purpose: Synthetic smoke-only protocol descriptor for the standalone Phase 2A PrescribedCalciumTransientV1 gate.

pendingOwnerDecisions.effect: Numeric knots in this artifact are synthetic smoke-only and are not accepted target-pack thresholds.

deferredExperimentalTargets.reason: Paired Land plus calcium acceptance belongs to Phase 2B or later owner/source-grounded target work.
Human ventricular rate-target acceptance is deferred until Decision 10 and source-grounded target packs are accepted.

syntheticParameterization.releasePulse: C1 raised-cosine pulse generated from canonical ActivationEvent plus activationDelaySec.
syntheticParameterization.riseMapping: tauRiseSec is solved deterministically so a zero-initial single-pulse BE waveform peaks at the synthetic riseTimeSec descriptor.
syntheticParameterization.normalization: N is recomputed for each interpolated effective target from a zero-initial single-pulse BE simulation.
